name: Quote card
summary: Card with a big decorative quotation mark, the quote word-wrapped over several lines and an author line.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y; the card grows with the quote

params.name: quote
params.default: Small steps still move you forward.
params.note: word-wrapped; up to about six lines

params.name: author
params.note: shown as an em dash then the name

params.name: color
params.note: quotation mark and author colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

example.quote: Small steps still move you forward.
example.author: Jordan Lee

author: krakujs
